name: Touhou SWINGHOLIC Music Pack
teaser: Jazz from the Touhou Circle Swingholic
description_html:
WARNING: DUE TO GOOGLE DRIVE DELETING FILES WHEN UNZIPPED DOWNLOAD BOBBY’s MUSIC PLAYER FIRST AND THEN THIS MOD. MOVE ONLY THE AUDIO FILES NOT THE DLL. ALT SOLUTION: Download the ZIP files from my link in Bobby’s Mod Page and then unzip them to a folder or desktop

The mod adds in Music from the Touhou Circle SWINGHOLIC. It’s jazz songs with some vocal ones. at least 100 songs plus. Credit goes to the Circle and the artists involved.

Install Instructions: Put BepinEx Folder into SPT Directory

Preview: https://youtu.be/lcaiCZfR0a0?si=ebHzaUunDHbiWyYo (it’s cute so why not)
